prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production animated floating mask companion sprite sheet for the 2D adventure game VOICES.
Input image 1 is the user's requested NEW visual design and style reference, not a background to retain.
Replace the previous plain wooden-mask design. Expand this reference character into EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS: 32 equal square sprite cells on a tall 1:2 aspect-ratio sheet, ideally 1024 by 2048.
Match the reference closely: elongated tapered reddish mahogany carved face, expressive turquoise almond eyes with heavy black eyeliner, red lips, orange and gold brow/nose shapes, bold green/yellow/orange triangular cheek paint, white bead dots, gold hoop earrings, a red/gold patterned forehead band and central round turquoise jewel. Five large vivid feather plumes in yellow, gold, orange, magenta and purple. Bright rich cartoon adventure art, clean dark outlines and hand-painted game shading, crisp simple shapes readable at 48px. Preserve the exact same face, earrings, feather count, colors and proportions in ALL cells. This is a fictional fantasy mask, no real cultural attribution or specific deity. No body, no extra props.
Frame layout, each row four frames left to right:
ROW 1: front view idle blink: eyes open, half closed, fully closed, reopening.
ROW 2: turned left three-quarter idle blink: open, half, closed, reopening. Keep mask symmetrical, show carved thickness.
ROW 3: turned right three-quarter idle blink: open, half, closed, reopening.
ROW 4: front magical investigation pulse: normal open eyes, jewel/eyes brighter, turquoise eyes and jewel glowing strongly with painted gold accents catching light, settling back to normal. Restrained glow entirely near facial details, preserve crisp silhouette.
ROW 5: front speaking loop: lips slightly apart, small open mouth, rounded speaking mouth, lips nearly closed; attentive eyebrows; no big teeth or tongue.
ROW 6: front curious/thinking loop: one eyebrow raised, eyes looking left, eyes looking right, brows soften; subtle attached feather sway. No question marks.
ROW 7: front surprised reaction: brows rise eyes widen, eyes wide and small O mouth, mild surprised half-recovery, settle. Keep expression friendly.
ROW 8: front happy/celebration loop: gentle smile, larger smile with joyful eyes, closed happy eyes, smile relaxes; slightly lively feather shapes.
Keep registration stable: same face center, same vertical placement, same face scale in all 32 cells. Fully show ALL feathers and earrings within EVERY cell with 12 percent padding; never touch neighboring cells. Fixed camera, no scene or floor. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, alpha zero between characters. Do NOT retain the input's black background. No baked cast shadows, tiles, frames, swatches, grids, labels, numbers or text. Do not simplify into the old undecorated brown mask.
